P.text: In L2TokenReceiverV2::increaseLiquidityCurrentRange, the protocol uses block.timestamp as the deadline argument when interacting with the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager.
P.evidence_quote: the protocol currently uses `block.timestamp` as the `deadline` argument when interacting with the Uniswap Nonfungible Position Manager

I.text: The deadline parameter should provide a protective effect by not equaling the transaction mining timestamp, so the deadline check is not a no-op.
I.evidence_quote: Using `block.timestamp` as the deadline has no protective effect because the timestamp corresponds to the moment the transaction is mined. As a result, the deadline check compares `block.timestamp` against the same value, rendering it a no-op.

V.text: The deadline parameter's purpose is defeated; pending transactions can be executed maliciously at a later time, e.g., by MEV bots or malicious actors at a disadvantage to the original submitter.
V.evidence_quote: Without a proper deadline, pending transactions can be executed maliciously at a later time.
